name: Scallywags
source:
A more terrifying band of pirates you'll never see! The crew has just scored its biggest plunder yet.
Now we join them as they discuss who should get the biggest share of the loot.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31450]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
一支你从未见过的更可怕的海盗团伙！船员们刚刚获得了迄今为止最大的战利品。
现在我们加入他们，讨论谁应该获得最大份额的战利品。
